items.title_cn: 甘油三酯降低幅度与高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎患者临床硬结局的关联：系统评价与剂量反应荟萃分析方案
items.title_en: The association between the magnitude of triglyceride reduction and clinical hard outcomes in patients with hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis: a protocol for systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis
items.abstract_cn: 理由 高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）是一种严重疾病，与持续性器官衰竭的高风险相关。利用胰岛素、治疗性血浆置换或血液灌流等干预措施快速降低甘油三酯（TG），被广泛认为是急性期管理的基石。然而，TG下降幅度本身是否能转化为硬临床结局的改善，仍存在高度争议。近期的网络荟萃分析比较了不同的降TG方式，间接提示更快的TG下降可能并不一致地改善死亡率或器官衰竭。尽管如此，现有证据主要集中于治疗之间的分类比较（例如，方式A vs. 方式B），或将TG下降仅用作替代终点。INPLASY 1国际注册系统评价与荟萃分析方案平台 INPLASY高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎患者中甘油三酯下降幅度与临床硬结局之间的关联：系统评价与剂量-反应荟萃分析方案 Rao, JQ; Xu, W.
items.abstract_en: Rationale Hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) is a severe condition associated with a high risk of persistent organ failure.Rapid triglyceride (TG) reduction, utilizing interventions such as insulin, therapeutic plasma exchange, or hemoperfusion, is widely considered the cornerstone of acute management.However, whether the magnitude of TG reduction itself translates into improved hard clinical outcomes remains highly controversial.Recent network meta-analyses have compared different TG-lowering modalities, indirectly suggesting that faster TG reduction may not consistently improve mortality or organ failure.Nevertheless, existing evidence primarily focuses on categorical comparisons between treatments (e.g., Modality A vs. Modality B) or uses TG reduction merely as a surrogate endpoint.The INPLASY 1International Platform of Registered Systematic Review and Meta-analysis Protocols INPLASYThe association between the magnitude of triglyceride reduction and clinical hard outcomes in patients with hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis: a protocol for systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis Rao, JQ; Xu, W.
items.summary_cn: 该方案计划通过系统综述与剂量-反应荟萃分析，探讨高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎患者中甘油三酯降低幅度与硬临床结局（如持续性器官衰竭、死亡）之间的关联。摘要指出，尽管快速降TG被广泛视为急性期管理基石，但TG降低幅度本身能否改善硬结局仍存争议，现有证据多为治疗方式间的分类比较或将TG降低仅作为替代终点。

items.title_cn: 急性胆源性胰腺炎中预切开括约肌切开术与隔膜切开术的安全性：一项倾向评分匹配研究
items.title_en: Safety of precut sphincterotomy and septotomy in acute biliary pancreatitis: a propensity score–matched study
items.abstract_cn: 急性胆源性胰腺炎（ABP）中预切开技术的安全性仍存在争议，原因在于担心其加重胰腺炎症。我们评估了在ABP首次入院期间接受ERCP的患者中，预切开括约肌切开术和间隔切开术与临床结局的关联。在2024年1月至2025年7月期间于一家三级ERCP转诊中心识别的420例ABP患者中，9例在ERCP时未能实现胆道通路而被排除，剩余411例患者纳入分析。309例插管成功的患者被分为标准插管组（n = 227）和补救性预切开组（针状刀乳头切开术 n = 58，间隔切开术 n = 24）。主要终点为ERCP后主要操作相关并发症和/或ICU入住构成的复合终点——以及延长住院时间（LOS ≥4天）。采用多变量回归、倾向性评分匹配和逆概率加权进行分析。两组间基线特征具有可比性。标准插管组6.2%和预切开组7.3%的患者发生不良临床结局（p = 0.717），延长LOS分别为37.9%和34.1%（p = 0.548）。预切开与不良结局（OR 1.49，95% CI 0.48–4.66）或延长LOS（OR 0.86，95% CI 0.49–1.50）无显著关联；仅BISAP评分独立预测两者。结果在78对匹配队列及加权分析中保持一致。预切开后的所有不良事件均发生于针状刀乳头切开术后。在由经验丰富的内镜医师实施ERCP的ABP患者中，补救性预切开括约肌切开术或间隔切开术与更差的结局或延长住院时间无显著关联。鉴于事件数量有限，不能排除风险的中度增加。
items.abstract_en: The safety of precut techniques in acute biliary pancreatitis (ABP) remains controversial due to concerns about worsening pancreatic inflammation. We evaluated the association of precut sphincterotomy and septotomy with clinical outcomes in patients undergoing ERCP during the index admission for ABP. Of 420 patients with ABP identified at a tertiary ERCP referral centre between January 2024 and July 2025, 9 wıthout biliary access at ERCP were excluded, leaving 411 patients for analysis. The 309 patıents with successful cannulation were divided into standard cannulation (n = 227) and a rescue precut (needle-knife papillotomy n = 58, septotomy n = 24) groups. Primary endpoints were a composite of major procedure-related complications and/or ICU admission after ERCP—and prolonged length of stay (LOS ≥4 days). Multivariable regression, propensity score matching and inverse probability weighting were used. Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups. Adverse clinical outcomes occurred in 6.2% of the standard and 7.3% of the precut group (p = 0.717), and prolonged LOS in 37.9% and 34.1%, (p = 0.548). Precut was not significantly associated with adverse outcomes (OR 1.49, 95% CI 0.48–4.66) or prolonged LOS (OR 0.86, 95% CI 0.49–1.50); only the BISAP score independently predicted both. Results were consistent in 78 matched pairs and with weighting. All adverse events after precut followed needle-knife papillotomy. In ABP patıents undergoing ERCP by an experienced endoscopist, rescue precut sphincterotomy or septotomy was not significantly associated with worse outcomes or prolonged hospitalization. Given the limited number of events, a moderate increase in risk cannot be excluded.
items.summary_cn: 在因急性胆源性胰腺炎行ERCP的患者中，由经验丰富的内镜医师实施补救性预切开括约肌切开术或隔膜切开术，与不良结局（6.2% vs 7.3%）或住院时间延长（37.9% vs 34.1%）无显著关联，仅BISAP评分独立预测两者；但事件数有限，不能排除中等程度的风险增加。

items.title_cn: GLP-1受体激动剂治疗肥胖的安全性：胃肠道及胰胆不良事件及其对临床实践的意义
items.title_en: SAFETY OF GLP-1 RECEPTOR AGONISTS IN OBESITY TREATMENT: GASTROINTESTINAL AND PANCREATOBILIARY ADVERSE EVENTS AND IMPLICATIONS FOR CLINICAL PRACTICE
items.abstract_cn: 肥胖是一种慢性、多因素疾病，与代谢和心血管疾病相关，需要持续且个体化的治疗。胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1 RAs），主要是利拉鲁肽和司美格鲁肽，以及葡萄糖依赖性促胰岛素多肽（GIP）和GLP-1双受体激动剂替尔泊肽，拓展了体重管理的药物治疗选择。其日益广泛的使用也引发了对安全性、耐受性和并发症管理的疑问。本叙述性综述讨论了用于肥胖治疗的肠促胰岛素类疗法不良事件的证据，重点关注胃肠道和胰胆事件。通过主题综合法审查了2015年至2025年间发表的随机试验、荟萃分析、观察性研究和临床指导文件。胃肠道事件，尤其是恶心、呕吐、腹泻和便秘，影响大部分患者，与剂量相关，集中在剂量递增阶段，通常为轻至中度。体重减轻在很大程度上独立于这些症状。胃排空延迟对镇静或麻醉下的操作具有影响。随机试验的荟萃分析显示，胆囊和胆道疾病风险较高，尤其是在较高剂量、较长使用时间和减重适应症中，而与急性胰腺炎的因果关系仍不确定。持续性胃肠道丢失导致的脱水可在脆弱患者中引起急性肾损伤，尽管某些药物在特定人群中具有肾脏保护作用。安全使用取决于仔细的患者选择、逐步滴定、患者教育、关注警示信号以及纵向监测。
items.abstract_en: Obesity is a chronic, multifactorial disease associated with metabolic and cardiovascular disorders that require continuous and individualized treatment. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), mainly liraglutide and semaglutide, and the dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and GLP-1 receptor agonist tirzepatide have expanded pharmacological options for weight management. Their growing use also raises questions about safety, tolerability, and the management of complications. This narrative review discusses the evidence on adverse events of incretin-based therapies used for obesity, with emphasis on gastrointestinal and pancreatobiliary events. Randomized trials, meta-analyses, observational studies, and clinical guidance documents published between 2015 and 2025 were examined through thematic synthesis. Gastrointestinal events, especially nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and constipation, affect a large proportion of patients, are dose-related, concentrate in the escalation phase, and are usually mild to moderate. Weight loss occurs largely independently of these symptoms. Delayed gastric emptying has implications for procedures under sedation or anesthesia. Meta-analyses of randomized trials show a higher risk of gallbladder and biliary disease, particularly at higher doses, with longer use, and in weight-loss indications, whereas a causal link with acute pancreatitis remains uncertain. Dehydration from persistent gastrointestinal losses can lead to acute kidney injury in vulnerable patients, even though some agents protect the kidney in specific populations. Safe use depends on careful patient selection, gradual titration, patient education, attention to warning signs, and longitudinal monitoring.
items.summary_cn: GLP-1受体激动剂及替尔泊肽用于减重时，胃肠道不良事件（恶心、呕吐、腹泻、便秘）常见且呈剂量相关、多集中于剂量递增期，通常为轻中度；随机试验的荟萃分析显示胆囊及胆道疾病风险升高（尤其高剂量、长期使用及减重适应证），而与急性胰腺炎的因果关系仍不确定。胃排空延迟对镇静或麻醉下操作有影响，持续胃肠道丢失所致脱水可致易感患者急性肾损伤。

items.title_cn: 坏死性胰腺炎后并发胰管离断综合征及胰结肠皮肤瘘需行结肠切除术
items.title_en: DISCONNECTED PANCREATIC DUCT SYNDROME AND PANCREATICO-COLO-CUTANEOUS FISTULA AFTER NECROTIZING PANCREATITIS REQUIRING COLECTOMY
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题报告了坏死性胰腺炎后发生胰管离断综合征及胰-结肠-皮肤瘘、需行结肠切除术的病例情况；摘要未提供，无法总结更多具体发现。

items.title_cn: 血浆置换在高甘油三酯血症诱发的急性胰腺炎中的作用
items.title_en: O papel da plasmaférese na pancreatite aguda  induzida por hipertrigliceridemia
items.abstract_cn: 目的：通过文献综述分析血浆置换在高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎治疗中的作用，并将其与保守治疗在甘油三酯降低、死亡率、住院时间及并发症方面进行比较。文献综述：高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎的临床重要性日益增加，可能与更高的病情严重程度和全身并发症相关。尽管快速降低甘油三酯被认为很重要，但关于血浆置换的证据仍然有限，主要依赖于观察性研究和存在方法学局限性的综述。近期系统综述未显示血浆置换相对于常规治疗（包括胰岛素治疗和强化支持）具有一致的优越性——尤其在死亡率和并发症方面。因此，其应用仍限于选定的、更为严重的病例。最终考虑：血浆置换的使用仍存在争议，尚无既定共识。尽管血浆置换能快速降低甘油三酯水平，但缺乏关于其临床获益优越性的有力证据，限制了其常规使用。其适应证应基于疾病严重程度、对常规治疗的反应以及临床团队的评估进行个体化决策，有待更高质量的研究建立更为一致的推荐意见。
items.abstract_en: Objective: To analyze, through a literature review, the role of plasmapheresis in the treatment of hypertriglyceridemia-induced acute pancreatitis, comparing it to conservative treatment regarding triglyceride reduction, mortality, length of hospital stay, and complications. Literature review: Hypertriglyceridemia-induced acute pancreatitis is of growing clinical importance and may be associated with greater severity and systemic complications. Although rapid triglyceride reduction is considered important, evidence regarding plasmapheresis remains limited, relying predominantly on observational studies and reviews with methodological limitations. Recent systematic reviews do not demonstrate consistent superiority of plasmapheresis over conventional treatment—including insulin therapy and intensive support—particularly regarding mortality and complications. Thus, its use remains restricted to selected, more severe cases. Final considerations: The use of plasmapheresis remains controversial, with no established consensus. Despite rapidly reducing triglyceride levels, the lack of robust evidence regarding superior clinical benefit limits its routine use. Its indication should be individualized based on disease severity, response to conventional treatment, and the clinical team's assessment, pending higher-quality studies that establish more consistent recommendations.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出，尽管血浆置换可快速降低甘油三酯水平，但近期系统评价未显示其较传统治疗（胰岛素治疗及强化支持）在死亡率、并发症等方面具有一致优势，其应用仍限于部分重症病例，指征需个体化，尚缺乏高质量证据。

items.title_en: Valproate rechallenge after acute pancreatitis in an adolescent with a pathogenic SPINK1 variant

items.title_cn: 老年患者急性胰腺炎后持续性高血糖：诊断挑战
items.title_en: Persistent Hyperglycemia After Acute Pancreatitis in an Older Adult: Diagnostic Challenges
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题提示其关注急性胰腺炎后持续性高血糖的诊断挑战，属于急性胰腺炎远期代谢并发症范畴，与研究方向中急性胰腺炎的诊治相关，但未涉及内镜诊疗或重症胰腺炎阶梯治疗等核心内容；由于无摘要，无法提取更多具体发现。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
